guitar.evidence: Jim Root (also of Slipknot) is well documented for his Fender signature Telecaster and Stratocaster models, used in Stone Sour as well.

tone.target: polished alt-rock crunch with slight fuzz edge
tone.profile: polished alt-rock crunch with slight fuzz edge
tone.summary: A tight, mid-focused signal chain using a light OD boost and Distortion for crunch, paired with an AC30 style amp and 4x12 cab to achieve the polished alt-rock sound with subtle fuzz texture.
corrections: keep fuzz subtle, not full fuzz

rig.name: Stone Sour - Through Glass - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up hum and unwanted noise inherent in high-gain alt-rock tones.
Provide the initial mid-gain crunch and slight grit required for alt-rock texture without sounding like a full overdrive.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is used as a light boost/grit source, mimicking a low-gain tube screamer or similar pedal to achieve the 'crunch' requirement.

blocks.purpose: Introduce the required 'slight fuzz grain' and harmonic complexity without overwhelming the tone. Kept low to avoid full fuzz.
blocks.gap: The RAT-style is dialed back significantly (low drive) to act more as a subtle texture/harmonic enhancer rather than a primary distortion source, fulfilling the 'slight fuzz' requirement.

blocks.purpose: Provide the classic Marshall-style voicing and mid-range punch essential for polished alt-rock.
Simulate the required Marshall-style 4x12 cabinet voicing for a full and present sound.
Tighten the low end and boost the present mids to ensure clarity and definition in the mix.
blocks.gap: Using a dedicated EQ module for surgical tone shaping is necessary to meet the 'tight low end' and 'present mids' requirements.

blocks.purpose: Add subtle width and polish to the tone without introducing heavy modulation or wash.
blocks.gap: Chorus is used minimally (low mix/depth) purely for 'polish' rather than a noticeable effect, fulfilling the need for controlled texture.

blocks.purpose: Provide a subtle sense of space and polish without the 'big delay wash' or excessive reverb.
blocks.gap: The Room reverb is kept at a low mix to provide ambiance rather than becoming an effect, adhering to the 'drop moderate delay/reverb' correction.

blocks.purpose: Delay is intentionally bypassed (or set to minimal) as per the 'drop moderate delay' correction.
blocks.gap: None. The module is included but deactivated to ensure compliance with the musical verdict.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism and tonal depth by swapping the default IR for a more specific, high-quality 4x12 voicing.

proposals.reason: Enhance the specific Marshall-style voicing and mid-range punch required for polished alt-rock.
proposals.expectedGain: Increased clarity and definition in the upper mids.
